messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: production error-rate spike detected for model redwood-medium-v2 in us-west1. 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 6.8% over last 10m. Pager: oncall-ana. Please ack and follow incident runbook :rotating_light:

sarah-eng: acked. I'm seeing a quality regression signal too — several customers complaining about hallucinations / responses truncated. correlates with the v2 rollout at 2026-02-18T04:02Z in us-west1.

oncall-ana: I'm on it. quick check: is this limited to redwood-medium-v2 in us-west1 or global?

raj-sre: logs look regional — us-west1 shows elevated tail latency and knative retries. other regions normal. also noticing GPU memory pressure on a subset of nodes after that deploy.

olivia-eng: stacktrace snippets show KV cache misses and repeated cache warmups after the model change. suspect new attention kernel in that variant.

sarah-eng: agreed. mitigation options: 1) pin incoming traffic to redwood-medium-v1 (previous stable) 2) immediate rollback of the v2 canary 3) apply temp rate-limiters. I'd prefer pin/rollback to minimize customer impact.

oncall-ana: can we do automated pin to v1 for affected customers while we diagnose? need to avoid broad rollback if not necessary.

raj-sre: we have a hot route-level pin API. sample command to pin route to a fixed model:
```bash
# pin route 'text-gen-prod' to redwood-medium-v1
redwoodctl route pin --route text-gen-prod --model redwood-medium-v1 --region us-west1 --reason "emergency rollback due to 5xx/quality spike"
```
I'm ready to run that unless objections.

mike-cs: quick heads-up — we have 3 enterprise customers on us-west1 who reported degradations. If we're pinning, can we prepare a short customer note. They need ETA and whether data was impacted.

emma-prod: I'll draft customer copy. Keep it short and factual. templates below.

olivia-eng: I'd like to capture a canary snapshot first (logs + model config) before pin. deploy-bot: can you create a snapshot?

deploy-bot: Snapshot created: deploy-snap-1932104567. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-deploy-snapshots/1932104567.tar.gz.

oncall-ana: ok, running pin now. raj, please run the route pin CLI and confirm.

raj-sre: running...
```bash
redwoodctl route pin --route text-gen-prod --model redwood-medium-v1 --region us-west1 --reason "emergency rollback due to 5xx/quality spike"
# => OK: route text-gen-prod now pinned to redwood-medium-v1 in us-west1
```

raj-sre: Pin applied. Monitoring metrics... 5xx rate dropping in the next 2 mins.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigation applied (route pin to redwood-medium-v1). Partial recovery observed. Continue monitoring. Incident severity: Sev2 -> assessing customer impact.

mike-cs: Emma — please send this short customer template to the affected accounts. I'll follow up with the account owners.

emma-prod: Customer notification draft (short):
"Hello — we detected increased error rates and quality regressions affecting text generation in the us-west1 region. We have reverted traffic to a previously verified model variant (redwood-medium-v1) while we investigate. No customer data was exposed or changed. We will post a status update at https://status.redwood.ai with a timeline and follow-up notes. Estimated follow-up: 2–4 hours. Contact: mike-cs@redwood.ai for account-specific questions"

mike-cs: looks good. sending now. :email:

oncall-ana: ops checklist next:
- confirm traffic recovery across all routes (raj)
- collect core dumps / heap profiles for problematic nodes (olivia)
- escalate to model-onboarding if kernel regression (sarah)
- update status page (emma)
- prepare rollback postmortem template (sarah)

raj-sre: traffic metrics now near baseline: 5xx ~0.3%. tail latency recovering. leaving extra alerting on for 1h.

olivia-eng: starting profile collection now, saving to /var/tmp/incidents/1932104567. grabbing recent KV cache metrics and attention kernel traces.

sarah-eng: flagged model-onboarding and eng-ml to review the v2 kernel change set: @olivia-eng please add annotated diff in the thread when available.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled at 1932116167 (8h from now). @oncall-ana please leave a short handoff note when done.

oncall-ana: Will do. current status: mitigation applied, recovery confirmed, customer notifications sent. I'll collect logs and hand off to night oncall with runbook and outstanding tasks.

emma-prod: Status page entry (draft):
Title: Degraded text generation and increased error rates in us-west1 — Partial mitigation applied
Body: We observed elevated error rates and quality regressions for model redwood-medium-v2 in the us-west1 region starting ~2026-02-18T04:02Z. We reverted traffic to redwood-medium-v1 and are seeing recovery. We are investigating root cause; no customer data was affected. Next update within 2 hours.

mike-cs: CS thread created and enterprise emails sent. I'll keep account owners updated.

olivia-eng: attaching initial diagnostic snippets in the next message (profiles + suspicious kernel logs).

raj-sre: doing an immediate post-mortem checklist: timeline, impact, mitigation, long-term fix, rollforward plan. Will draft in incidents/postmortems once priority cleared.

oncall-ana: Handoff note for next oncall:
- What happened: v2 deploy caused KV cache churn and kernel memory spikes, causing 5xx and degraded output quality.
- What we did: pinned affected routes to redwood-medium-v1, snapshot created, customer comms sent, profiles collected.
- Outstanding: eng-ml to triage kernel changes; decide on rollback vs patch; follow-up postmortem.

sarah-eng: adding postmortem owner: olivia-eng + raj-sre. I'll support with model diffs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation successful, monitoring continues. Severity -> Sev3 monitoring. Next scheduled update at 1932110767.

oncall-ana: Leaving now — handoff complete. tagging next-oncall. thanks all. :pray:
